# ankra_service_placement_policy (Resource)

A cluster's managed-service placement policy: the region it runs in, the data boundary its data stays within, and whether its services serve only consumers on the same cluster. The counterpart of `ankra services policy set` and `get`. It is the organisation's declaration, not verified location evidence.

The platform has no route that removes a declaration, so destroying this resource only removes it from state: the cluster keeps its last declared policy. Updates carry the revision Terraform last read, so a declaration changed by someone else in between is refused rather than overwritten.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_service_placement_policy" "prod" {
  cluster_id    = "9f4c2d1e-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f"
  region        = "eu-north-1"
  data_boundary = "eu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the policy is declared for. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `data_boundary` (String) Boundary the data may stay within, for example `eu`.
- `region` (String) Physical region the cluster runs in, for example `eu-north-1`.

### Optional

- `local_only` (Boolean) Whether services on the cluster serve only consumers on the same cluster. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `revision` (Number) Revision of the declaration; it increases with every change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Placement policies are imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_service_placement_policy.prod 9f4c2d1e-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
```
